title: emaqi Service Adds Streaming Under My Control, The Soldier Groom and the Daikon Bride, Shin Ikki Tousen, 8 More Manga
content: AI localization company Orange Inc. announced on Tuesday that its emaqi e-bookstore service is adding 11 new exclusive titles this month. Eight of the new titles will be available through its " emaqi Premium" monthly subscription service.
author: ANN

title: Short Net Anime Studio Plott to Start Producing Over-the-Air TV Anime
content: Plott , a production company known for producing short net anime streamed on YouTube , announced on Tuesday its foray into the terrestrial television anime business next year. title: 'Sudachi no Maoujou' Unveils Main Cast Member, Second Teaser Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Makoto Morishita 's Sudachi no Maoujou ( The Fledgling Demon Lord's Starter Shop ) manga unveiled an additional main cast member, key visual (pictured), and second teaser promotional video on Tuesday.

title: A World Space Week Pokémon × ESA Collaboration Has Launched
content: The world is currently celebrating World Space Week. And as part of that celebration, The Pokémon Company and the European Space Agency (ESA) are launching the main part of their World Space Week collaboration: the Field Research and Wild Encounters Pokémon GO gameplay.
author: Anime Corner

title: The Fledgling Demon Lord's Starter Shop Anime's 2nd Teaser Reveals More Cast, January Debut
content: The official website for the television anime of Makoto Morishita 's The Fledgling Demon Lord's Starter Shop ( Sudachi no Maōjō ) manga presented on Tuesday the anime's second teaser promotional video, key visual, additional cast member, and January 2027 premiere on the Tokyo MX , MBS , BS11 , and other channels.
author: ANN

title: The Otome Heroine's Fight for Survival Anime's Teaser Unveils Staff, Cast, July 2027 Debut
content: The staff for the anime of author Biyori Harunohi and illustrator Yu Hitaki 's The Otome Heroine's Fight for Survival ( Otome Game no Heroine de Saikyō Survival ) light novels unveiled an English-subtitled teaser promotional video and visual for the anime on Tuesday.

title: 'Otome Game no Heroine de Saikyou Survival' Unveils Main Staff, Cast for Summer 2027
content: Production company Slow Curve opened an official website for the Otome Game no Heroine de Saikyou Survival ( The Otome Heroine's Fight for Survival ) anime project on Tuesday, revealing the main staff, lead cast, a teaser visual (pictured), special promo, and its television format.

title: Netflix’s Biggest Martial Arts Anime Returns With a Wild Look Ahead of Anime’s Return
content: The critically acclaimed sequel series of the Baki franchise returned with a brand new chapter in February this year as part of the Winter 2026 anime lineup. One of the biggest anime on Netflix is the Baki franchise, an acclaimed martial arts series based on the manga by Keisuke Itagaki.
